items.description: General reference and background knowledge. Select an English edition that fits the drive before downloading.

items.title: Preparedness reference pack
items.description: Select current preparedness guides from Ready.gov, listed in the Kiwix catalog, and test the chosen archive.
items.reader: Compatible Kiwix reader for the selected archive
items.rights_note: Catalog listing reviewed; no exact archive downloaded or rights-cleared. Ready.gov pages returned 403 during this session.

items.title: Repair references
items.description: Select useful iFixit guides for devices and equipment in the household; an offline option is listed by Kiwix.
items.rights_note: Select exact guides and review their licensing and attribution requirements before redistribution.

items.title: Regional street maps
items.description: Choose a Memphis-area map pack, then confirm the viewer works offline at useful zoom levels.
items.keywords: memphis tennessee arkansas mississippi roads navigation
items.reader: An offline viewer matched to the map format
items.rights_note: OSM data terms, the map provider's package terms, and viewer licensing must be checked separately. No map package selected.

items.title: Topographic maps
items.description: Choose useful USGS map sheets and keep the map margins, edition details, and credits intact.
items.reader: PDF reader or selected geospatial viewer
items.rights_note: Review each exact map's credits; third-party layers may have separate terms. No map files included.

items.title: Health guide candidates
items.description: Evaluate Hesperian titles and editions as reference additions, with their original context and notices.
items.reader: Depends on the selected book format
items.rights_note: Noncommercial scope does not remove all conditions. Review title-specific copying permissions, attribution, and clinical currency before sharing.

items.title: Kiwix reader
items.description: Select and test a Windows reader before adding ZIM archives. The reader and its content are separate downloads.
items.rights_note: Review the selected software release's license and redistribution obligations separately from every content archive.
